moment.nsmotionusagedescription.zh-Hans: 在您开始运动后读取本机步数，用于散步、慢跑等运动记录。
moment.nsmotionusagedescription.en: Linko Moment uses motion data to count steps during your exercise sessions.

moment.nscamerausagedescription.zh-Hans: 扫描孩子手表的二维码以填写配对码并确认绑定。
moment.nscamerausagedescription.en: Linko Moment uses the camera to scan watch pairing QR codes.

moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.zh-Hans: 在活动拍照、打卡或搜索附近餐厅时获取位置；开启运动地图后记录并同步轨迹。仅当您主动开启活动位置共享时，向当前活动成员显示位置，离开活动或进入后台即停止。
moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.en: Use location for activity photos, check-ins, nearby dining, and workout routes. Only when you enable activity location sharing, show your position to current activity members. Sharing stops when you leave the activity or the app enters the background.
